story.what_it_does: CMPDI is a government-owned mining consultant and a subsidiary of Coal India, listed in March 2026. It does exploratory drilling, geological work, coal sample testing and consultancy, with FY2025-26 revenue of ₹2,316.53 crore. Most of its sales (₹1,939.41 crore) are to group companies including Coal India.
story.plans: Management's stated targets are drilling of 12.0 lakh metres in FY2026-27 (11.50 lakh achieved in FY2025-26) and procurement from small enterprises of ₹84 crore. A final dividend of ₹1.06 per share is proposed for the AGM on 17 August 2026. The later results presentations give no new forward targets.
story.moat: Its position as Coal India's in-house consultancy brings a large, steady stream of group work, with ₹131.02 crore of jobs won outside the group. Its drilling, geology and lab capacity (67,113 coal samples analysed) is specialised. The notes also flag that expert staff are retiring and that this depletes its expertise.

scenarios.story: Revenue and profit keep growing, as in H1 FY27 with revenue up about 12% and profit up about 23%, and the one-time pay charge does not recur. Drilling moves toward the 12.0 lakh metre target and outside-group work grows.
signals_to_watch: Profit after tax growth versus the H1 FY27 level of ₹311.11 crore
Drilling progress toward the 12.0 lakh metre target for FY2026-27
